approach: Keep `git diff <ref>` (working tree against a commit) from writing .git/index by adding `git --no-optional-locks`.
failure_symptom: With an out-of-date index (a file touched but unchanged), `git --no-optional-locks diff --name-status <ref>` still rewrote .git/index (mtime changed; git 2.50). The switch does not cover `git diff`. Fix used: run that diff with GIT_INDEX_FILE pointing at a temporary copy of the index. Plain `git diff-index` without refreshing doesn't write but reports touched-but-unchanged files as modified.
